preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The grid contains only unmarked ('.'), and marked ('X') cells.

preconditions.expression: No marked cell is adjacent to the edge of the grid
preconditions.description: All marked cells are surrounded by unmarked cells.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if a suitable grid exists, or 'NO' if it does not.
If the output is 'YES', the following conditions are true:

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= cell <= 5 for cell in grid)
postconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains a number between 0 and 5, inclusive.
Each marked cell contains a multiple of 5.

postconditions.expression: all(cell in {1, 4} or cell in adjacent_sums for cell in unmarked_cells)
postconditions.description: Each unmarked cell contains either 1 or 4, or the sum of the numbers in all unmarked cells adjacent to it.

postconditions.expression: all(cell == sum(adjacent_cells) for cell, adjacent_cells in zip(marked_cells, adjacent_sums))
postconditions.description: Each marked cell contains the sum of the numbers in all unmarked cells adjacent to it.
